subject: AP vendor setup: required PO reference fields, bank remit bundle, and VAT note
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acmeinc.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Billing Ops <accounts@acmeinc.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration request & PO field guidance

Hi Rachel,

We're creating Redwood Inference as a vendor in Acme's procurement system. Before we finish the vendor record a couple of items popped up on our side and I wanted to confirm:

- Legal name must match tax docs exactly — can you confirm the name on your W‑9 and provide the EIN?
- For invoices in our EU entity, do you accept VAT on invoices (we need VAT registration number) or do we self‑bill?
- Our AP system requires a single PO reference field "PO_REF" (32 chars) and an optional freeform "SUB_REF" for routing. Can you confirm how you prefer POs to appear on invoices? Example accepted format: ACME-PO12345 / Redwood-INV-2026-XYZ.

If you can drop your AP onboarding bundle and bank remit info we can complete the setup.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it helps.

Emma Liu
Senior Procurement Specialist
Acme Inc.
emma.liu@acmeinc.com
+44 20 5555 1234

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Billing Ops <accounts@acmeinc.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration request & PO field guidance

Emma —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached is our AP onboarding packet and the signed W‑9. Quick answers below and a couple of asks for your mapping team so invoices match and payments route cleanly: 

1) Legal/tax name + EIN
   - Legal name on W‑9: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - EIN: 82‑3456789

2) VAT / EU billing
   - Redwood currently invoices with VAT when required by law; for most EU customers we provide a VAT registration number or invoice without VAT where reverse charge applies. If your EU entity wants to self‑bill, please confirm and we will enable the self‑billing flag and provide the necessary acceptance form.

3) PO field format (recommended)
   - Preferred invoice PO line: PO_REF should contain your primary PO identifier (max 32 chars).
   - We will populate SUB_REF with our internal order id when present. Example invoice line: PO_REF=ACME‑PO12345; SUB_REF=RED‑ORD‑5489.

4) Payment routing
   - We prefer EFT (ACH/SEPA) for production payments. Bank remit details are in the attached Bank_Remittance_Instruction.txt. Please let us know if you require a bank verification/test wire.

Action items for Acme (to finish vendor record):
- Confirm whether Acme EU wants VAT on Redwood invoices or to self‑bill (reply inline).
- Create vendor entry with Legal name exactly as W‑9 and attach the onboarding packet.
- If possible, create a test PO so we can send a test invoice and confirm PO_REF mapping.

Cc'ing Laura (Finance) to help with any bank verification.

Best,

Rachel Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0190

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.xlsx (spreadsheet), W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (tax form), Bank_Remittance_Instruction.txt (plain text containing account / IBAN examples)

From: Billing Ops <accounts@acmeinc.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@acmeinc.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration request & PO field guidance

Hi Rachel / Emma,

Thanks for the packet and the details. A few follow ups from our onboarding checklist after a quick pass:

- Legal name match confirmed (we will use "Redwood Inference, Inc." per W‑9).
- For EU invoices: Acme EU currently requires supplier VAT registration unless vendor has formal self‑billing agreement. Emma — please confirm if your team can accept self‑billing.
- PO mapping: our EDI team maps incoming invoices to three fields: PO_REF (required), SUB_REF (optional), and INVOICE_REF (internal). We can accept the PO_REF format you propose.

Could Finance provide a sample invoice with the PO_REF and SUB_REF populated so we can validate our extract mappings? If you prefer, you can send a one‑line CSV mapping example instead of a live invoice.

Also, we need a redacted bank verification file: a PDF with bank name, account last four, IBAN prefix — you can redact full account numbers and we will complete a micro‑deposit/SEPA test.

Best,

Acme Billing Ops
accounts@acmeinc.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Billing Ops <accounts@acmeinc.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration request & PO field guidance

Hi — Laura here from Finance (cc Ben from Account Execs). Appreciate the quick review.

I've attached a one‑page sample invoice and a one‑row CSV mapping that shows how we populate PO_REF and SUB_REF. Notes:
- Sample invoice: Invoice 2026‑00421 shows PO_REF=ACME‑PO12345 and SUB_REF=RED‑ORD‑5489 in the header. Line level PO references are not used today.
- VAT: Redwood has EU VAT registration number GB999999999. If Acme EU will self‑bill, please send the self‑billing acceptance form and we will countersign; otherwise we'll include VAT on invoices to your EU entity.
- Bank verification: attached is a redacted bank remit text file (Bank_Remittance_Instruction.txt) with bank name, IBAN prefix and last 4 for verification. For SEPA verification we accept a micro‑deposit test or the standard confirmation letter via your vendor portal.

Requested next steps from Acme:
1) Create vendor record with legal name and attach W‑9.
2) Create a test PO (ACME‑TEST‑0001) and reply with the PO id so we can issue a test invoice.
3) Confirm whether Acme EU will self‑bill or require VAT on Redwood invoices.

Ben — looping you for awareness so you can confirm expected payment terms and follow up on the earliest payment cutoff (Acme has 30/60 depending on approval flow).

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
